name: Paltel Data Center - Al-Bireh / Ramallah
notes: Paltel's second data center, launched Oct 2019 (DCD 2019-10-01; DCPostMEA 2019-10-03 with PM Shtayyeh at launch). ~65,000 sq ft / ~6,000 sq m, Uptime Tier III Design, ~USD 10M (Bloomberg/DCK). Services: colocation, DR, virtual servers, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, storage. Caveat: Uptime award page location line reads 'Nablus West Bank' while project name and operator/trade sources point to Al-Bireh/Ramallah; preserve the inconsistency.

name: MTDE National Data Center / Government Computer Center
developer: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Economy (MTDE) / Palestinian Authority
notes: Government data center in Ramallah context (MTIT HQ per World Bank Palestinian Digital Economy Assessment). Live NDC page confirms government collocation (hosting of government servers/equipment), DR-site hosting, DCIM monitoring, PalCERT monitoring, government private cloud, 17 hosted government institutions, 270 virtual servers, 109 hosted government websites, 23,500 e-government users. Domain caveat: mtde.online is official-looking but not mtde.gov.ps; cross-checked against World Bank/WAFA.

name: Zone Technologies Data Center (Zone Ramallah)
notes: Small local cloud/VPS/storage provider lead. DataCenterMap lists 'Zone Data Center' at Masrouji Building, 3 Al Madaen Street, Ramallah/Al-Bireh; Zone site markets cloud/VPS/storage. No verified facility spec, Tier, power, commissioning date, or permit - directory/marketing evidence only (C+/B- lead).

name: Paltel Data Center - Nablus HQ (first Paltel data center)
notes: Paltel's own Arabic announcement confirms an earlier strategic data-center project at the company's general-management headquarters in Nablus. Historical/limited-spec: no public capacity, Tier, MW, or current-status details beyond public HQ context (Rafedya Main Street, Nablus). Jawwal 'Nablus Data Center' service page (high availability, power/bandwidth redundancy, backup to separate site) was indexed by search engines but currently returns 404; treat as secondary.

name: Paltel Gaza main data centers / switches
notes: Pre-war Paltel institutional data centers/switches in Gaza. WAFA (2023-11-16) reported gradual shutdown from fuel depletion; 7amleh (2024) reported 75% of Gaza telecom infrastructure damaged, at least 50% destroyed; NYT (2024-03-13) cited Paltel saying ~80% of network offline. Current status is damaged/intermittently restored/unknown - NOT normal operational without a 2025-2026 A-grade operator/official confirmation.

name: Digital Communication Gaza (DCC Facilities)
notes: Directory-only lead (Inflect) for a Gaza City data center at Omar Al-Mokhtar St with UPS power noted. No operator/official confirmation of current status; must not be counted as operational without 2025-2026 primary source and must be read against war-damage evidence.
